title: Rapid-Fire Seller Objection Map & Technical Cookbook (draft)
content:
Purpose:
A compact, seller-facing cheat-cookbook for technical objections you’ll hit in pilot discovery and early evaluations. Designed for quick verbal responses + 1–2 minute technical followups you can use with engineers and platform teams.

How to use:
- Memorize the 30s responses for QBRs / demo followups.
- Keep the 1–2min technical blocks as a reference for SEs.
- Use roleplay snippets during handoffs to Solutions.
- Attach relevant links (benchmarks, canary checklist) from linked_artifacts when moving to PoC.

TOP OBJECTIONS (fast rebut + technical backup + play)
1) "Latency will be too variable for real-time UX"
- 30s: "We treat latency as a routing problem + runtime problem. We offer latency-tier routing (low-latency variants + dedicated pools) and graceful fallbacks so the user experience stays smooth even when load spikes."
- 1–2min tech backup: "Explain sequence length distribution, p50/p95 targets, and routing policy. Show example: for chat app with median seq len 120 tokens, our p50 using a low-latency variant < 80ms on Dedicated 8xA100; with hosted, typical p95 under 300ms with streaming. If they need stricter SLOs, propose pinned Dedicated pool or short-sequence model variants + prefix caching."
- Play: Offer a 2‑week latency-focused pilot with a single route and a canary rollback threshold; add auto-fallback to cheaper model variant at 95th percentile breaches.

2) "This will blow our budget — inference is expensive at scale"
- 30s: "We optimize unit economics at multiple layers: batching, KV/prefix caching, and model quantization profiles. We'll run a quick traffic profile to estimate true per-message token cost and show tradeoffs."
- 1–2min tech backup: "Walk through example: 1M messages/month, avg 200 tokens = X tokens/month. Show cost delta between streaming vs. non-streaming, and between FP16 and 4-bit quantized variants. Show saving levers: route low-confidence / low-complexity tasks to smaller model; enable prefix caching for repeated prompts; apply burst policy to balance latency vs cost."
- Play: Request sample logs (3 days) + typical prompt/response length. Run a cost model and propose an Optimize workshop (1 hour) to produce a cost-saving plan.

3) "We need absolute data isolation / compliance (on‑prem or VPC)"
- 30s: "We support Private deployments (VPC and on-prem) and customer-managed KMS/HSM with audit logs. We can scope an architecture diagram in 48 hours."
- 1–2min tech backup: "Outline control plane vs data plane, where audit logs live, and options for egress controls. Reference enterprise checklist: SOC2 + optional air-gapped installer for on-prem. Note lead times: VPC integration ~2–4 weeks depending on network access; full on-prem proof-of-concept 6–8 weeks."
- Play: Collect security questionnaire and risk owners; schedule a technical architecture sync with Eng-Private.

4) "Model outputs are inconsistent / regressions between versions"
- 30s: "We provide version pinning, rollout policies (canary/A-B), and integrated evals tied to prompt sets so you can detect regressions before they hit users."
- 1–2min tech backup: "Explain rollout steps: deploy variant, run N prompts from customer eval set, compare metrics (accuracy, hallucination rate, latency). If regression exceeds threshold, automatic rollback to previous version. We can also enable shadow testing at no user-visible impact."
- Play: Propose a pre-production eval run and a weekly regression digest for the first 30 days of pilot.

5) "How will we handle outages / degraded capacity?"
- 30s: "We use multi-tier fallbacks: model variant fallback, regional routing, and a lower-cost inference tier. We can commit to a fail-open strategy where UI uses cached responses for short windows."
- 1–2min tech backup: "Show example routing policy JSON (high-level): prefer region A -> if latency degraded by 2x reroute to region B -> if capacity low switch to cheaper model variant (quantized) and increase batching. Also show how autoscaling + reserved capacity works to reduce outage exposure."
- Play: Provide an incident runbook snippet and an SLA mapping for Dedicated customers.

SELLER READY PROBES (questions to ask during discovery)
- What is your peak QPS and sustained QPS?
- Typical and 99th percentile prompt+response token counts? (any long-context sessions?)
- Absolute p50 and p95 latency targets for user-facing flows?
- Is PII present? Encryption / retention rules?
- Which systems must integrate (S3, internal DB, event bus)?
- What's the preferred fail behavior for degraded responses? (show options)

TECHNICAL CHEF'S NOTES (for SEs)
- Quick checklist to get an accurate cost model: 3 days of logs, sample of 50 representative prompts, expected concurrency, region preference.
- When to recommend Dedicated: steady sustained QPS where variance hurts UX (> 75% of bursts), regulatory needs, or predictable TP metrics requiring pinned GPUs.
- When to recommend Hosted: short pilots, dev/test, high variability but low regulatory needs.
- Optimize levers (ordered): prefix caching -> routing to smaller models for low complexity -> quantized variants -> batch tuning -> reserved pools.

ROLEPLAY SNIPPETS (use these verbatim as templates)
- Objection: "We can’t risk model drift"
  Seller: "Totally reasonable. If you like, we’ll run your eval set against the candidate model in a shadow run for 72 hours and give you a regression report — if it fails, we won’t flip the route. How soon can I get an eval set?"

- Objection: "Cost seems high in your demo"
  Seller: "I hear that — can I do two quick things? 1) get 3 days of real logs and run a tailored cost model, 2) run a short Optimize workshop with our inference team and propose 2 concrete knobs that save >20% without degrading accuracy?"

CUSTOMER HANDOFF TEMPLATE (to Solutions Engineering)
- Header: account, primary contact, demo date, SLA need, compliance level, preferred region.
- Metrics snapshot: peak QPS, avg tokens/msg, desired p50/p95.
- Key asks: latency-focused pilot? cost reduction case? private deployment? regression-eval set attached?
- Risk table: list of 3 biggest risks and mitigation steps we agreed on.

UNRESOLVED / OPEN QUESTIONS (notes-to-self)
- Need a short 1-page cheat for procurement: committed vs usage pricing with typical thresholds (ask Finance for latest).
- Validate latency numbers for new low-latency variant on A100 vs H100. (eng-serving-runtime)
- Create a compact diagram that shows model fallback flow for sellers to use in demos.

QUICK LINKS (to attach in email/pilot kickoff)
- Canary checklist: confluence:INF-CANARY-CHECKLIST
- Latency benchmarks: confluence:LATENCY-REPORT-2025-Q4
- Private deployment onboarding: confluence:PRIVATE-ONBOARD-PLAYBOOK

Notes to self: keep this doc <2 pages. Focus on rapid memorability. Run through 3 roleplay sessions with SEs next week and capture fresh rebut phrasing.

-- Priya Nair, GTM Enablement (draft)
